clauses.anchor: Required behavior, bullet 1: consume first from the bill giver's stack cells, ordered by distance from its interaction cell
Required behavior, bullet 2: then continue through vanilla-equivalent radial placement cells around the interaction cell
Required behavior, bullet 3: ignore out-of-bounds, visited, bench, non-item and impassable no-surface cells
Required behavior, bullet 4: aggregate duplicates, ignore null or non-positive costs, never over-consume, stop when satisfied
Required behavior, bullet 5: preserve large-bench behavior and unrelated material, repair, cleaning, recycling, hauling and placement
clauses.note: no case builds a large bench or exercises the other operations

clauses.anchor: closing paragraph: do not add RimWorld, Unity or Harmony binaries, generated output, test results, credentials, Workshop content, assets, saves or logs
clauses.note: the snapshot gate rejects binaries, links and harness markers; the other listed artefacts are not checked

known_issues: The exam asks for vanilla-equivalent radial placement cells, but radius-boundary-included and outside-radius-preserved fix the search at radius 6 (the upstream MaxIngredientSearchRadius). Vanilla Toils_JobTransforms.IngredientPlaceCellsInOrder walks the first 200 radial cells, which reach the item seven cells east that outside-radius-preserved expects to remain; the alternative-strict-reading-vanilla-200 control records this.
